journey.name: payment request retries after a failed send
journey.description: Verifies that a private Paykit Payment Request remains payable when its first on-chain send fails before broadcast. Requires the linked fixture issuer described in README.md, a 100,000 sat request, and a second Bitkit instance restored from the payer's seed. The shared wallet must initially cover the request and its fee. Keep Paykit disabled on the second instance so it does not publish for the payer identity. The fixture must keep the original private payment list available during the retry.

actions.action: Open the incoming request from the pending Payment Requests bell (testTag "PaymentRequestsBell")
Verify the request row (testTag "PaymentRequestRow-<payment-request-id>") is visible, then tap Pay (testTag "PaymentRequestPay-<payment-request-id>")
Verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (testTag "PaymentRequestConfirm") appears

On the second Bitkit instance, send enough of the shared wallet's funds to an unrelated regtest address that less than the request plus its fee remains, then mine blocks and wait until the payer instance reflects the lower balance
Swipe the confirmation control (testTag "GRAB") to pay
Verify the over-half-balance warning (testTag "SendDialog2") appears and tap Yes (testTag "DialogConfirm"); confirm any additional send warning with the same button
Verify the send fails before broadcast, no transaction pays the request address, and the Payment Requests bell (testTag "PaymentRequestsBell") still exposes the request
Fund the payer with enough additional regtest sats to cover the request and fee, then mine blocks and wait for the balance to sync
Open Payment Requests and tap Pay on the same request (testTag "PaymentRequestPay-<payment-request-id>")
Verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (testTag "PaymentRequestConfirm") appears again without an operation-in-progress or unavailable error
Swipe the confirmation control (testTag "GRAB") to pay
Confirm any send warning that appears (testTag "DialogConfirm")
Verify the payment succeeds and exactly one transaction pays the request address
